text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- State budget gives priority to defence; parliament to review 1997/98 budget on Tuesday.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index drops 2.9 points to 2,410.5.
- Parliament approves 1997/98 budgets of five public bodies; parliament holds extra session to review budgets of state institutions ahead of summer recess.
- Parliament refuses to approve 1997/98 budget for Kuwait Airways Corp after MPs accuse some of it officials of corruption and mismanagement resulting in huge losses.
- MPs attack colleagues who left Kuwait on holidays ahead of official start of parliament's summer recess.
- Parliament decides to publish in newspapers and broadcast on television names of MPs who miss sessions.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah sends message to Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa.
